purpose: Judge a hypothetical effort as unable to change the result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vた + ところで + limited / negative result
Even if we run now, we will not make it.
Even if you ask me, you will not get an answer.
Even lowering the price will not necessarily make it sell.
formation: Vた + ところで + limited / negative result
mistake: This is concessive, unlike Vたところ describing what actually happened.
